mintAuthority.summary: sdUSD (dSTAKE vault) is upgradeable via ProxyAdmin owned by a 24-hour TimelockController, whose proposer/executor/canceller is a single 3-of-5 Safe multisig (0xe83c188...). Shares are minted only by staking dUSD — no privileged mint surface. Fraxtal's DStakeProxyAdmin is owned by a separate 24-hour TimelockController (0x0bafaDA2...) whose proposer/executor/canceller role is a 3-of-5 Safe (0xFC2f89f9...) holding the identical five-owner set as the Ethereum Safe.

sources.label: Fraxtal sdUSD exact-match transparent proxy source

controls.label: dSTAKE Ethereum upgrade Safe (via 24-hour TimelockController)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295192, the sdUSD proxy admin was ProxyAdmin 0xbe90db309b80357631069b689fc3481aca2c65be, whose owner is TimelockController 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b with minDelay 86400 seconds. That timelock's proposer, canceller, and executor roles resolve to this Safe. At block 25573508 the Safe returned the five owners recorded here, threshold 3, and no enabled modules; the current upgrade path can change wrapper mint logic after the delay.

controls.label: dSTAKE sdUSD vault share accounting (Ethereum)
controls.capDescription: Ethereum sdUSD shares are minted only against deposited local dUSD and do not create base dUSD supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25570988, asset() on the dSTAKE vault returned local dUSD 0x07fff99e1664d9b116fbc158c0e99785f81ca236. The current vault share path is deposit-backed accounting.

controls.label: Inherited dUSD AMO/governed-reserve mint authority
controls.evidence: Resolved 2026-07-30 against the parent dusd-dtrinity authority graph. Underlying dUSD is minted by documented MINTER_ROLE contracts (Ethereum AMO Manager 0x29532F74A9302e0a1E9f7d015FE355FFdE6e6880, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) re-verified true at Ethereum block 25656501, plus the flagged undocumented second minter 0xf84cc8217713a53fc3e3eb2d62d2af33a084ff85) against a governance-set whitelist of reserve stablecoins, with AMO pre-minting into Curve pools. The dUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by the 86400-second TimelockController 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b (hasRole re-verified true at block 25656501) resolving to the same 3-of-5 governance Safe 0xE83c188a7BE46B90715C757A06cF917175f30262 as this wrapper; Fraxtal and Katana follow the same timelocked 3-of-5 pattern, while Sonic's admin sits directly under a 2-of-4 Safe with no timelock. The dUSD token exposes no supply cap, so the inherited authority can raise effective sdUSD backing supply without a cap; sdUSD share mint itself remains deposit-backed. sdUSD inherits this concentrated-admin posture, plus the March 17 2026 dTRINITY exploit exposure noted on the dUSD profile.

controls.label: dSTAKE Fraxtal upgrade Safe (via 24-hour TimelockController)
controls.evidence: At Fraxtal block 38906249, owner() on DStakeProxyAdmin 0xde914ec384346fea47339e5086d2d399b7f4733b returned 0x0bafaDA2a5824864720873EE40cd960b36445212, an OpenZeppelin TimelockController (getMinDelay()=86400 seconds), not an EOA. That timelock's only RoleGranted events (from deployment, no RoleRevoked events found) show PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE all granted to Safe 0xFC2f89f9982Be98A9672CEfc3eA6dbBDd88Bc8e9. The Safe (v1.3.0) returned the five owners recorded here, threshold 3, no enabled modules, and a zero guard — an identical owner set and threshold to the Ethereum-side Safe, deployed as a separate per-chain instance.

review.evidence: Ethereum control review is current: ProxyAdmin 0xbe90db309b80357631069b689fc3481aca2c65be is owned by the 86400-second TimelockController 0x18cb0eb73d953ed20f2157ce6bde2a85e30e681b, which resolves to the reviewed 3-of-5 Safe. The local wrapper share path is dUSD-deposit backed. Follow-up 2026-07-21: Fraxtal's distinct transparent proxy and DStakeProxyAdmin 0xde914ec384346fea47339e5086d2d399b7f4733b is owned by TimelockController 0x0bafaDA2a5824864720873EE40cd960b36445212 (getMinDelay=86400 seconds, not an EOA as previously stated), whose PROPOSER_ROLE/EXECUTOR_ROLE/CANCELLER_ROLE all resolve to Safe 0xFC2f89f9982Be98A9672CEfc3eA6dbBDd88Bc8e9 (3-of-5, same five owners as the Ethereum Safe, no modules, zero guard). Both chains' upgrade authority are now fully resolved. Re-verified 2026-07-27: at Ethereum block 25625502 the sdUSD proxy EIP-1967 admin slot still returns ProxyAdmin 0xbe90db309b80357631069b689fc3481aca2c65be, owner() is the TimelockController with getMinDelay()=86400, hasRole confirms PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE all held by Safe 0xe83c188a7be46b90715c757a06cf917175f30262, and the Safe returns threshold 3 with the same five owners; at Fraxtal block 39180535 DStakeProxyAdmin owner() is TimelockController 0x0bafaDA2a5824864720873EE40cd960b36445212 with getMinDelay()=86400 and Safe 0xFC2f89f9982Be98A9672CEfc3eA6dbBDd88Bc8e9 returns threshold 3 with the identical five owners. sdUSD shares are minted only against deposited local dUSD, so the wrapper mint is economically bounded by the staking vault contract; the timelocked 3-of-5 Safe can change that code after the delay.
